'Get advice on your training from an AI app you already use, like ChatGPT or Gemini.'
'MettleUp sends nothing. You choose where the text goes. Your name, phone number and body weight are left out.'
Button 'Share to an AI app' and under it 'The text you will share'
must_not: A spinner that never ends
The member's name, phone number or body weight anywhere in the text

steps.action: Read the text in the card
user_sees: 'My gym workouts from the last 4 weeks (<date> to <date>).'
'6 workouts in 4 weeks, about 1.5 a week.'
One line per exercise with best set, First, Latest and 'Going up.' / 'About the same.' / 'Going down.'
Ends with 'My question: Based on these workouts, what should I change in the next 4 weeks to keep getting stronger?...'
must_not: Warm-up sets counted as best sets
A workout older than 28 days in the text

steps.action: Tap 'Share to an AI app', pick ChatGPT
user_sees: The phone's share sheet, then ChatGPT with the text pasted
must_not: MettleUp sending the text to any server itself
The share sheet opening twice
Dark text on a dark background, a white flash between screens, or an unreadable chart or picture

note: Long text in a card on a settings page must scroll
